pageDescription: Whether you're new to Christianity or exploring the Anglican tradition, our classes provide a foundation for lifelong discipleship.
mainIntro: All are invited for this time of Christian discipleship. Our 9-week classes are designed for:
audienceItems: Those new to the Christian faith
Those seeking to learn more about Anglicanism
Those preparing for Confirmation, Reception, or Reaffirmation
Anyone wanting to deepen their understanding of the faith
mainClosing: Classes are held on Sundays after worship and last approximately one hour. You'll explore the essentials of Christian faith, Anglican heritage, and what it means to follow Jesus today.
ctaDescription: Contact the church office to learn about the next class session and receive your materials.
